reviews.text:
I had my Chihuahua-Poodle mix groomed.

■Good
- She looked very cute after the grooming. I think they're very skilled.
- Both the groomer and the photographer were women, and they were very friendly and easy to communicate with.
- I was happy to receive an instant photo.
- I was happy that the photo was posted on Instagram.

■More
- The slippery floor in the room was a slight concern.

■Summary
The grooming fee, including the teeth cleaning option (around 500 yen), was about 16,000 yen, which is a bit pricey, but she looked so cute that I would like to use their services again.
(The price seems to vary depending on the breed and type of fur.)

Thank you so much for giving Kobo such a cute haircut. The atmosphere was very warm and you treated my dog ​​with such care that I felt completely at ease entrusting him with his grooming. Your cutting technique was amazing, truly professional. His fluffy fur is irresistibly cute, and it's definitely the best haircut he's ever had. The videos and photos you took were also a wonderful memento for me as a pet owner, and I'm very happy with the result. I look forward to using your services again.
